# Illumia Solutions

> Illumia Solutions is a global IT services firm headquartered in Kolkata, India
> (98/9 Gopal Lal Tagore Rd, Baranagar, Kolkata 700036). Proxmox Silver Partner
> and Apache Guacamole Commercial Support Partner. Specialises in enterprise
> cybersecurity (PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2), open-source
> infrastructure (Proxmox, ERPNext, NetBox, Wazuh, OpenVAS), and cloud solutions.
> 20+ years of collective industry experience. Serves clients across India, USA,
> Philippines, Australia, Kenya, and Mozambique with 24/7 multi-timezone support.
> Contact: sales@illumiasolutions.com | +91 9332045178

## Business Summary

Illumia Solutions provides 47+ specialised IT service modules. Key capabilities:
- PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2, EU AI Act compliance
- EDR, SIEM (Wazuh/OSSIM), SOAR (Shuffle), PAM (Apache Guacamole), Honeypot (T-POT/MHN)
- Proxmox private cloud, VMware migration, Ceph storage, hyperconverged infrastructure
- ERPNext and NetBox implementation and managed hosting
- 24/7 multi-timezone managed IT support across 6 countries

## Certifications and Partnerships

Team certifications: CISA, CISSP, CEH, CCIE
Partners: Proxmox (Silver Partner), Apache Guacamole (Commercial Support Partner),
Seqrite, Zextras, NetBox Labs, Force Networks, LifeBank Foundation
